sloka: ततो दैवतसैन्यनां सङ्क्षोभः समजायत ।तदक्षयं महासैन्यं दृष्ट्वा समरमूर्धनि ।। ७.२७.२५ ॥
transliteration: tato daivatasainyanāṁ saṅkṣobhaḥ samajāyata ।tadakṣayaṁ mahāsainyaṁ dṛṣṭvā samaramūrdhani ।। 7.27.25 ॥

translations.english: Then, seeing that immense and inexhaustible great army at the forefront of the battle, agitation arose among the armies of the gods.
